queries.To build the core MMS CI resource: We wi: Methods for building a comprehensive multimodal scientific dataset by crawling open-access peer-reviewed Nature Communications articles and extracting titles, abstracts, main text, references, figures, and captions across 72 scientific disciplines.
queries.To prepare and structure the collected s: Methods for extracting and structuring scientific figure captions from peer-reviewed articles, converting LaTeX equations to plain text, using regular expressions to identify sub-figure captions, and categorizing diverse scientific figure types for multimodal large language model datasets.
queries.To test caption generation for scientifi: MMS CICAP benchmark for scientific figure captioning, where multimodal large language models generate captions for complex scientific figures in ungrounded and abstract-grounded settings from Nature Communications articles across multiple disciplines.
queries.To test figure-caption alignment: Figure: multiple-choice figure caption matching for multimodal large language models evaluating alignment between scientific figures, subfigures, captions, and subcaptions
queries.To assess benchmark performance across t: Evaluation metrics for multimodal large language model benchmarks on scientific figure captioning, multiple-choice questions, and materials science generation, including ROUGE, METEOR, BERTScore, modified FACTSCORE, G-EVAL, validity, coverage, property distribution, and stability
queries.To measure current MLLM capabilities: We: Evaluation of proprietary and open-source multimodal large language models for graduate-level multidisciplinary scientific figure captioning and figure caption matching
queries.To establish a human reference: We will: human evaluation baseline using computer science graduate students to assess multimodal large language models on scientific figure captioning and figure caption matching benchmarks
queries.To ensure fair and discipline-balanced e: balanced test validation split by scientific discipline using one percent of articles per subject to prevent content reuse in multimodal scientific figure understanding benchmark
queries.To turn the collected scientific article: Creating task-specific multimodal training data from scientific articles as single-turn and multi-turn conversations and interleaved text-image sequences for continuous pre-training of multimodal large language models to improve scientific figure understanding
queries.To test whether scientific data improves: Supervised fine-tuning, continuous pre-training of Qwen2-VL-2B using scientific article, figure data, interleaved text-image multimodal training, improving multimodal large language model understanding of complex scientific figures, evaluating scientific data benefits
queries.To demonstrate domain-specific downstrea: continuous pretraining of LLaMA2-7B on interleaved scientific content for materials science, evaluating material generation on MP-20 dataset with validity, coverage, property distribution, stability metrics
